description.en: Zombie that can throw snow balls towards his farthest target.
description.zh: 可以朝本行最远的目标投掷雪球。

chat.en: He won everyone else cuz no one is willing to be touched by his sparky helmet.
chat.zh: 他能称霸是因为没人想碰到他那满是刺的头盔。

text.en: snow balls cool down plants until they freeze into blocks
text.zh: 雪球能冷冻植物，直到植物被冻成冰块
